discovery.repository_finding: No SCXML/XState state machine source found in current repository; the existing index schema has state_transitions and app/history records implement approval records.
discovery.scope: Captured bytes only; parse structural SCXML declarations in the supported subset. No network, filesystem reference resolution, XInclude, interpreter, simulator, or target execution.

cases: content hash change invalidates to needs_review

oracle: Independent expected fact sets and diagnostics authored from the W3C 1.0 structural subset; no interpreter output or parser self-output used as oracle.

supported_subset.actions: record source references and names only; never interpret executable content
supported_subset.approvals: source facts start proposed; only explicit record approval becomes approved; changed source hash/scope becomes needs_review
supported_subset.guards: record source reference and analysis_status=unknown; never evaluate cond
supported_subset.hierarchy: nested sequential state elements; parallel/history are explicit unsupported gaps
